name: ololand-forensic-qoe
description: Forensic Quality-of-Earnings primitives as a standalone Claude plugin: Beneish M-Score, Benford's Law, EBITDA bridge, journal-entry testing, lapping detection, working-capital deep dive, and sourced covenant, cross-default, and MAC/MAE clause analysis. Wraps OloLand's deterministic forensic engines as the Pre-LOI Forensic Screen and Full QoE reports — included in OloLand Pro and above. Positioned against Big-4 QoE ($150-500K, 4-8 weeks).
